Synopsis

In a world where hope is a hollow shell, a broken girl with nothing left to lose crosses paths with a mysterious, caustic old man. Together, they enter a realm where time stands still and secrets unravel. Will she find salvation or be consumed by the void? Dive into the mystery—read Chapter 1 now!
